native.caveat: Actual pinned Hermes/loopback transport qualification uses counted authorization callbacks; real Foundation composition is exercised separately by ordinary integration tests. No provider entitlement/billing or deployed confinement qualification. Root independently reported postqualification core installation status and execution manifest validation passed with no model calls; no before/after manifest pair is claimed here.

cases: Real scoped conversation persists across reload with genuinely unavailable composer disabled

Labeled mobile UI contract consumes actual EventSource frames, shows partial text while running, reconnects without sending again, renders inert artifact text and exact proposal rejection without horizontal overflow
Labeled lost-response UI contract advances server revision then aborts first send response; after history refresh the verification send retains identical original revision/input/idempotency key
browser.caveat: Model turn/artifact/proposal browser states are labeled response fixtures after real owner enrollment/project/profile/conversation creation; these do not prove a native run traverses the browser and HTTP end to end. Existing default e2e.xml is overwritten by each targeted run; command output and retained test source identify the distinct 2+1 successful cases.

finalVisualQa.visualInspection: Both final viewport screenshots inspected: no skip-link overlay; desktop shows chat before profile section; mobile controls and transcript remain within viewport.
finalVisualQa.limitation: Tall-region element screenshot stitching had included an offscreen fixed skip link despite BODY focus. Final images use ordinary viewport screenshots without styles or masks; computed metadata is attached to the successful browser run.

mutation.caveat: Curated sensitivity only, not a whole-repository or touched-line mutation score. Copies use isolated Vitest aliases; shared production files were never edited. Vitest rejected-promise assertion failures carry Error rather than AssertionError and are explicitly classified as behavioral kills.

redBeforeGreen.missingFacadeScaffolding: Initial sixteen missing-method failures in hermes-chat-domain-red.xml are not counted as behavioral regression evidence.
redBeforeGreen.fixtureCorrections: Duplicate profile, wrong artifact storage column and a browser fixture field placement were corrected without weakening production requirements.
redBeforeGreen.behaviorSensitivity: Four isolated mutants demonstrate green baseline, behavioral assertion failure and restored green. No claim that those faults existed in production.

gaps: Root coordinates complete ordinary regression, build, source/security review and final global acceptance; this report does not count those results.
No dedicated deterministic mid-transaction prune/read scheduling fault injection was added; ordinary retention boundary and serialized source-copy mutation sensitivity are measured.
No full coverage percentage, property-fuzz campaign or repository-wide mutation score was measured.
No actual paid provider, server deployment, hostile-code OS containment or broad operational tool execution was exercised.
